hardware.gpu_memory_note: Integrated GPU using shared system memory; the adapter-reported 16GB label does not mean 16GB of dedicated VRAM.

bottleneck_attribution: Unresolved: these global thread measurements include waits; no specific CPU or GPU bottleneck was established.
